description: This file contains functions and documentation for managing reproducible build source date epochs within the OpenEmbedded build system. It handles determining, reading, and writing environment variables to ensure reproducible build timestamps, with specific logic for source control and known files.

methods.name: get_source_date_epoch_from_known_files(d, sourcedir)
methods.description: Determines the source date epoch from known files like NEWS, ChangeLog, by checking their modification times.

methods.name: find_git_folder(d, sourcedir)
methods.description: Locates the .git directory within the working directory or source directory.

methods.name: get_source_date_epoch_from_git(d, sourcedir)
methods.description: Fetches the last commit timestamp from a git repository to determine the source date epoch.

methods.name: get_source_date_epoch_from_youngest_file(d, sourcedir)
methods.description: Determines the source date epoch from the newest file in the source directory.

methods.name: fixed_source_date_epoch(d)
methods.description: Fallback method that uses a predefined timestamp if no other method succeeds.

methods.name: get_source_date_epoch(d, sourcedir)
methods.description: Aggregate function that determines the source date epoch from git, known files, or fallback.

methods.name: epochfile_read(epochfile, d)
methods.description: Reads the source date epoch from a file, with caching and fallback.

methods.name: epochfile_write(source_date_epoch, epochfile, d)
methods.description: Writes the source date epoch to a file safely, creating necessary directories.
